title: Stop the AI Fix-Break-Fix Loop with 3 Rules
description:
AI fixes one bug and breaks another? Give it three rules! 🔁

✅ Tell AI to fix only the failing test
✅ Run all tests after each change
✅ Revert the fix if a new test fails

Day 9 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 10, Write a Postmortem Prompt for Bugs.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #ai #chatgpt #softwaredevelopment #debugging
comment: Revert or tests: which rule would you add first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: paste all three rules at the top of your AI chat, so every fix starts with the same guardrails.
